protocol: Run the production buildProjections and buildSeasonForecasts functions at the end of each season’s first fourteen calendar days. Veteran parameters train only before the target season. The college-model metric-selection policy uses the development class three years before the target; college coefficients train only on earlier classes. After development on 2024-25 identified rookie undercoverage, pool historical replay residuals through 2024-25; condition on rookie/returner/mover status. Use 1/2/4 prediction bands at <80/<320/320+ observations, borrow a parent group below 40, then freeze and evaluate 2025-26 without using its outcomes to select widths. Both preseason context and current-team observed updates run through production code.
boundary: Roster membership is reconstructed from appearances known at the cutoff, not archived signed-contract rosters; signed nonappearers are unobserved and future entrants are counted outside the cohort. Listed positions and immutable birthdates use the preserved identity index. Historical schedule reconstruction uses final schedule dates. Historical injury/contract reports are unavailable, so those input states use the same unavailable fallback as production. Unit/source tests separately cover dated official Out reports and two-way ceilings. This is a chronological replay with stated source limitations, not a pristine prospective trial or proof of calibrated probabilities in 2026-27.
